title: Argument Reasoning in Civil Procedure
description: Legal argument reasoning task from SemEval-2024 Task 5. Given a short introduction to a U.S. civil procedure topic, a question, and a candidate answer (a possible solution argument), annotators perform binary classification: judge whether the answer candidate is correct (True) or incorrect (False). Questions and answers are drawn from a civil procedure textbook widely used in U.S. law schools.
